summary: Tested the landing page and brand sign-in (A), Notes In CSV (B) and the Doorstep Photo Hint (C). Backend: 8/8 new pytest cases passed (tests/test_csv_note_doorstep_hint.py, -n0), and the 8 iteration-21 saved-notes regression tests also passed. CSV checks: delivery_note and the gate_code alias prefill customer_note with source 'saved' and upsert/replace the saved note; whitespace is collapsed and notes are cut to 200 chars; a blank cell falls back to the saved note and does not clear it; the template includes delivery_note. Doorstep hint checks: null with no history; it picks the latest delivered stop with a photo for the same phone and address, and ignores newer no-photo stops and other addresses; the signed photo_url returns 200 with the exact bytes without auth; admin also sees the hint; anon gets 401 and another driver gets 403. Frontend (390x844 and 1280 wide): the landing page renders all requested testIDs with no overlap and readable text (hero is white Poppins on a dark gradient). The track box goes to /customer/MD1001 and the header link goes to /customer. Merchant sign-in shows errors for empty fields, wrong password and the admin account (merchant-only), then lands on /merchant/mer-1. Revisiting the page redirects, and brand-back-button returns to /. Staff sign-in: wrong admin password, merchant-on-staff and wrong driver PIN all show errors. Admin goes to /admin and driver goes to /driver/drv-1, and revisiting the page redirects for both roles. The gated /admin, /driver/drv-1 and /merchant screens sign in correctly. The driver stop screen shows doorstep-hint with the photo loaded (naturalWidth 600), hides it for stops without history and hides it for a delivered (closed) stop. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

minor.issue: The hint matches the exact address string and searches across all merchants. A manually created stop whose address is formatted differently (for example without ', San Francisco', or with different case) gets no hint. A photo taken for merchant A is shown on merchant B's stop to the same customer. That is acceptable for the driver, but worth confirming as intended.

ui_bugs.issue: The Columns hint lists notes, window_date, window_start, window_end and priority, but not the new delivery_note (gate_code) column, so merchants won't find the feature. Reference: /app/frontend/app/merchant/[merchantId].tsx:124

issues: The header logo starts at x=80 but the section content starts at x=104. BrandHeader uses paddingHorizontal 20 and the container uses 24 inside the same 1120 max width, so the left edges are 24px apart.
autoCapitalize='characters' has no effect on web, so the code shows as 'md1001' while typing. Navigation still uppercases it. Consider uppercasing in onChangeText.
The driver form card is at x=20 with width 350, while the toggle and admin card are at x=24 with width 342. The card shifts about 4px when you switch tabs.
The perk says 'Simple per-delivery pricing in CAD', but the service area is San Francisco with US phone numbers. Check that this is intended (billing does show CA$).

action_items: Add delivery_note (alias gate_code) to the CSV columns help text in app/merchant/[merchantId].tsx:124
Optional: align the BrandHeader horizontal padding (20) with the landing container (24)
Optional: uppercase the landing track input value in onChangeText for web
Optional: normalise the address match (case and trimmed ', San Francisco') for doorstep_hint, and decide whether it should be scoped to a merchant
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3570 lines and should be split into modules (carried over).
doorstep_hint does an unindexed find on stops (customer_phone + address + status) on every GET /stops/{id}. Consider a compound index.
The signed hint photo_url expires after 120 min. If the stop screen stays open longer without a refetch, the image may stop loading.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 medium UI copy gap

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ stops (cloned, delivered, with an uploaded pod photo) and test saved_notes for +14155550166/67. All were removed, login_attempts drv|trk were cleared, and POST /api/admin/reset returned 200.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0. To seed the doorstep hint for the UI, run python tests/seed_ui_iter22.py, which prints the target stop id on drv-1's active route. Afterwards delete stops with customer_name /^TEST_/, clear login_attempts drv|trk, and call admin reset. The merchant CSV template is at GET /api/merchant-template.csv.
